extensionDescription.message: Open films on Letterboxd from Google Search and selected text.

resultSearchDescription.message: Find the film in Letterboxd search.

getToken.message: Get your API Read Access Token

persistentCache.message: Keep TMDB matches after closing Chrome

cacheHelp.message: Reuses confirmed matches for up to 24 hours.

privacyData.message: The extension uses film details from supported Google Search pages and text you select when you use the context menu. Opening a result sends its ID, film URL or search text to Letterboxd. With TMDB enabled, the extension sends titles, years and language to identify films and may use an ID to fetch a film poster. The extension has no analytics, advertising or developer-operated server.

privacyToken.message: The TMDB token stays in trusted extension storage. It is sent in the authorization header to the TMDB API. You can remove it under TMDB and cache. Chrome's local storage is not an encrypted vault.

privacyCache.message: Confirmed film matches expire after 24 hours and are stored in the current browser session by default. You can keep them between sessions or clear them under TMDB and cache.

configured.message: Token saved. Test the connection to check it.

tmdbDisabled.message: TMDB is off. The token is still saved.

rateLimited.message: TMDB rate limit reached. Try again later.

unavailable.message: Could not complete the action. Try again.

tmdbUnavailable.message: Could not connect to TMDB. Try again later.

permissionDenied.message: TMDB site permission was not granted.

enterToken.message: Enter a TMDB read access token.
